title: Amazon Will Begin Selling Trainium AI Chips Outside AWS in Late 2027
summary:
The company's customized Trainium hardware, currently available only through its cloud division, will be made available for direct purchase by external buyers starting in late 2027. CEO Andy Jassy said the move is intended to establish a substantial new business line by selling the artificial intelligence chips outside of Amazon Web Services.

Jassy noted that while external sales provide immediate revenue, the chips produce higher total revenue and free cash flow when used internally over a 5 to 6 year period. By selling the hardware externally, Amazon intends to maintain its internal cloud revenue while adding a direct hardware sales stream.
